prompt: Precise flat vector op-art composition for a website hero, 16:9. Hundreds of thin parallel vertical lines of equal width alternate vermilion red and ultramarine blue on an ivory background and cover the whole canvas edge to edge. In the left-centre of the canvas the lines bend smoothly outward around a large empty horizontal rounded-rectangle area (about 46% of the width and 42% of the height), as if pushed aside by an invisible lens, leaving that area perfectly clear ivory. Near its boundary the lines compress and curve, creating a vibrating optical bulge in the spirit of Bridget Riley. Crisp geometry, consistent spacing, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no text, no letters.
